entities.summary: Johan Cremer was a Dutch author, photographer and painter. His best known work is the novel Ik, Jan Cremer and the sequel Ik, Jan Cremer, tweede boek. The publication of this book created scandal in the Netherlands because of its explicit sexual contents. He was also active as photographer and painter.
